title.zh: 条件的对应纪律：只有交互才经由条件相关，惰性条件不再免费连通，连通由活的使用造成
title.en: A correspondence discipline for conditions: only interaction relates through a condition, idle conditions no longer connect for free, and connection is made by living use

claim.zh: 在依存网的逐步读法上，保留 living（活跃且不侵蚀），把 related 从共同参与收窄为交互：两个事件经由某条件相关，仅当一方汲取它、另一方以正水平依存于它，在任何步上（不排定时间，也不问汲取是否改变水平）。没有活动汲取、或没有依存能落空的条件是惰性的：它不构成任何关系，也不使任何事件侵蚀；加入它不改变 living、关系与连通。于是独立审查 Q4 的免费连通被排除：加入人人在水平 0 依存、无人汲取的条件，在共同参与下使每个网连通，在交互下连通不变。每个侵蚀关系都是交互；在 N_rel 下，珍视一个侵蚀事件的立场，必珍视被侵蚀形成在以正水平依存于该条件的每一步上的活的事件。传递由汲取承担，不由侵蚀承担：珍视任何汲取事件的立场，必珍视以正水平依存于该条件的每个活的事件（drawing_reaches），所以审查 Q5 只有共同依存的一半被排除。一个条件，每个活的事件都汲取它或以正水平依存于它，且有活的汲取者与活的依存者，使整体连通，任意两个活的事件至多经两次交互相连；于是 G0 在那里恰等于种子加 N_rel 加 N_std。在一个例子中，两个依存于同一条件的形成，经由维持其支持的使用连通；唯一的使用侵蚀它们时不连通；共同参与在两次运行中都连通它们。加入一个被更新、人人以正水平依存的条件，只要一个活的事件汲取它一次，仍使每个网在交互下连通而不改变 living（one_use_connects）；不需要人人汲取。不用 Lean 公理，不加伦理谓词。
claim.en: On the stepwise reading of a web, keep living (active and not undermining) and narrow related from co-participation to interaction: two events are related through a condition only when one draws on it and the other depends on it at a positive level, at any steps (neither order in time nor change of level enters). A condition that no activity draws on, or no dependence on which can fail, is idle: it relates nothing and undermines nothing, and adjoining one leaves living, the relation and connection unchanged. So the free connection of the independent review's Q4 is excluded: adjoining a condition every formation requires at level zero and nothing draws on connects every web under co-participation and leaves connection unchanged under interaction. Every undermining relation is an interaction; under N_rel, a standpoint valuing an undermining event holds significant the living events of the formation it undermines at every step where that formation depends on the condition at a positive level. The transmission is carried by drawing, not undermining: a standpoint valuing any drawing event holds significant every living event depending on the condition at a positive level (drawing_reaches), so only the co-dependence half of review Q5 is excluded. A condition that every living event draws on or depends on at a positive level, with a living drawer and a living dependent, connects the whole, any two living events being linked in at most two interactions; G0 there is exactly a seed with N_rel and N_std. In one example two formations depending on one condition are connected through a use that keeps their support, and not when the only use undermines it, while co-participation connects them in both runs. Adjoining a renewed condition on which every formation depends at a positive level, used once by one living event, still connects every web under interaction without changing living (one_use_connects); every formation drawing on it is not needed. No Lean axiom is used and no ethical predicate is added.

hypotheses.zh: 依存网与逐步读法如 becoming-stepwise-reading 所设；draws 不带数量；交互像共同参与一样，不排定两个事件的时间次序，也不问汲取是否改变水平（Later、Pinned.drawing_interacts）。
hypotheses.en: The web and the stepwise reading are those of becoming-stepwise-reading; draws carries no amount; like co-participation, interaction does not order the two events in time, and it does not ask whether the drawing changes the level (Later, Pinned.drawing_interacts).

hypotheses.zh: 连通的结论需要一个每个活的事件都承担于其上的条件，并有活的汲取者与活的依存者；刻画结论还需要至少一个活的事件；传递结论需要 N_rel，其规范地位不由本结果证明。
hypotheses.en: The connection result needs a condition on which every living event bears, with a living drawer and a living dependent; the characterization also needs some living event; the transmission result needs N_rel, whose normative standing this result does not prove.

correspondence.zh: 纪律是公开的对应选择，不是展开的推论。交互是结构上的共现：一方汲取、另一方以正水平依存于同一个能使之落空的条件，在任何步上；它还不是“一方的汲取落在另一方的支持上”，那需要排定时间、对效果敏感的版本，开放。共同依存，即两个形成依存于同一条件，是纪律所省略的关系（经由共同条件的共同构成），不是没有关系；Shared 显示省略它的代价，应用若要把它算作关系，须写出它。纪律排除的是结构上不能承载交互的条件，不是虚假的汲取或依存声明：一个被更新、人人以正水平依存、被一个活的事件使用一次的条件，在网上与真实的共同条件（例如人人呼吸的空气）无法区分，它给出的连通是一个须由应用检验的事实主张。共同参与这一选择及其后果（Q4）仍保留在核心上；选择哪一种由 Ren 决定。
correspondence.en: The discipline is a disclosed correspondence choice, not a consequence of the unfolding. Interaction is a structural coincidence: one draws on, and the other depends at a positive level on, one condition that can fail it, at any steps. It is not yet one formation's drawing bearing on another's support; that needs an ordered, effect-sensitive version, which is open. Co-dependence, two formations depending on one condition, is a relation the discipline omits (co-constitution through a common condition), not an absence of relation; Shared exhibits the cost of omitting it, and an application that counts it must write it out. The discipline excludes conditions that structurally cannot carry interaction, not false claims of drawing or dependence: a renewed condition on which every formation depends at a positive level, used once by a living event, is indistinguishable on the web from a genuine common condition (say, the air everyone breathes), and the connection it gives is a factual claim that application must check. The co-participation choice and its consequence (Q4) remain on the core; which to adopt is Ren's decision.

detail.zh: Web.interaction 的 living 恰是 Web.valuation 的 living；交互蕴含其共同参与；inert_connects 用其 connected_of_common 重述 Q4。
detail.en: The living of Web.interaction is exactly that of Web.valuation; interaction implies its co-participation; inert_connects restates Q4 with its connected_of_common.

output.zh: 逐步读法、共同参与与侵蚀。
output.en: The stepwise reading, co-participation and undermining.

input.zh: 交互之下的关系与连通。

detail.zh: significant_iff_of_renewable 直接调用 Valuation.significant_iff，所需的连通由 connected_of_renewable 给出。
detail.en: significant_iff_of_renewable applies Valuation.significant_iff directly, with connection supplied by connected_of_renewable.

output.zh: 连通整体上 G0 的刻画。
output.en: G0's characterization on a connected whole.

detail.zh: 该记录在对应纪律下由共同条件给出连通，并记下纪律尚未陈述；本结果给出一条。
detail.en: That record gives connection from a common condition under a correspondence discipline and noted the discipline was not yet stated; this result states one.

detail.zh: 两者都只改变读法的一个分量：该结果改变比较所用的 living，本结果改变 related，living 不变。
detail.en: Each changes one component of the reading: that result the living used in comparison, this one related, with living unchanged.

detail.zh: 在本纪律下，承担自身的形成直接相关：汲取它与它的每个活跃事件相互作用；不承担自身的互利者不相关。陈述在同一模块新增的一节。
detail.en: Under this discipline, formations bearing on themselves relate directly: drawing on one interacts with each of its active events; mutualists not bearing on themselves are not related. Stated in a new section of the same module.

detail.zh: 交互之外的两种 related：以之为生沿用“依存须能落空”的纪律，世系要求正的给予与开始作为条件而在；两者都依赖一类读法的同一对应。
detail.en: Two readings of related beyond interaction: living on keeps the discipline that the dependence can fail, and descent needs a positive gift and coming to stand; both depend on the one-kind identification.

detail.zh: 纪律排除不了人人汲取并以正水平依存的被更新条件（universal_connects）：加入它，living 不变，每个网都连通。
detail.en: The discipline does not exclude a renewed condition that every formation draws on and depends on at a positive level (universal_connects): adjoining one leaves living unchanged and connects every web.

detail.zh: 纪律的代价（Shared.connection_by_living_use）：唯一的使用侵蚀依存者时，依存者彼此不经由该条件连通，而共同参与连通它们。
detail.en: The discipline's cost (Shared.connection_by_living_use): when the only use undermines the dependents, they are not connected to each other through the condition, while co-participation connects them.

detail.zh: 审查 Q10 未解决：人人汲取的粗的共同条件在其依存落空时使汲取它的事件不 living；纪律只改变关系，不改变 living。
detail.en: Review Q10 is not resolved: a coarse common condition that every formation draws on withholds the events drawing on it once a dependence on it fails; the discipline changes relations, not living.

detail.zh: 剩余的免费连通比“人人汲取”更便宜（Web.one_use_connects）：对任何有一个活的事件的网，加入一个人人在水平 1 依存、只被该事件的形成在该步汲取一次的条件，条件被更新，living 不变，网在交互下连通（第三次独立审查 G8）。
detail.en: The residual free connection is cheaper than “everyone draws on it” (Web.one_use_connects): for any web with a living event, adjoining a condition on which every formation depends at level 1, drawn on once by that event's formation at its step, keeps the condition renewed and living unchanged and connects the web under interaction (third independent review G8).

detail.zh: 交互不排定时间（Later.drawing_connects_earlier）：第 5 步的汲取与只在第 0 步成立的依存交互，并连通二者，虽然它不能落在那一依存上（第三次独立审查 G7）。
detail.en: Interaction does not order time (Later.drawing_connects_earlier): a drawing at step 5 interacts with, and connects, a dependence held only at step 0, which it cannot bear on (third independent review G7).

detail.zh: 交互不问效果（Pinned.drawing_interacts）：汲取者的事件与旧依存者交互，虽然汲取与不汲取的两次运行水平处处相同（第三次独立审查 G7）。
detail.en: Interaction does not ask about effect (Pinned.drawing_interacts): the drawer's event interacts with the old dependent, though the two runs that draw and rest have the same levels everywhere (third independent review G7).

detail.zh: 审查 Q5 只有一半被排除（Web.drawing_reaches）：在 N_rel 下，珍视任何汲取事件的立场，必珍视以正水平依存于该条件的每个活的事件，不论汲取是否侵蚀任何东西（第三次独立审查 G9）。
detail.en: Only half of review Q5 is excluded (Web.drawing_reaches): under N_rel a standpoint valuing any drawing event holds significant every living event depending on the condition at a positive level, whether or not the drawing undermines anything (third independent review G9).

detail.zh: 第三次独立审查：P8、P9 与 P7b 的全部声明接受，公理报告为空；MetSince 须比较那一步的所需（已修正），依存中断一步即开始新的一段（已披露），but-for 须动作可取（已修正）；散文在逐步读法的代价、节制、替代、交互与剩余的免费连通上强于 Lean（已更正，整合文档 §12）。
detail.en: Third independent review: every P8, P9 and P7b declaration is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on the stepwise cost, restraint, substitution, interaction and the residual free connection (corrected, integration note §12).

limitations.zh: 只对逐步读法陈述；依存不变时经 K.dependence.along r 适用，整段读法可取同一关系，这里没有做。不处理时间次序与汲取的效果；不改变 living；不选择读法；不推出责任或义务。
limitations.en: Stated for the stepwise reading only; with fixed dependences it applies through K.dependence.along r, and the whole-run reading could take the same relation, which is not done here. Does not order events in time or ask about the effect of drawing; does not change living; chooses no reading; yields no responsibility or duty.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261012T012916.201078Z）：Becoming.Correspondence 中本记录的 25 项定理全部空依赖（模块另有 12 项定理属于 life-as-condition-of-life）；同一回执覆盖包内 57 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 2970 项定理／4334 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致。作者反审见整合文档 §10；另一 agent（Claude Opus 5.5，未参与撰写）作了独立审查（BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md），其更正在整合文档 §12 处理。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 59 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261012T012916.201078Z): the 25 theorems of Becoming.Correspondence belonging to this record all have empty axiom reports (the module's other 12 belong to life-as-condition-of-life); the same receipt covers the package's 57 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 2970 theorems/4334 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts. The author's counterreview is in §10 of the integration note; a separate agent (Claude Opus 5.5, not an author) reviewed it independently (BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md), and its corrections are handled in §12. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 59 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 排定时间、对效果敏感的交互（汲取不晚于依存，且水平随汲取而异）及其连通类，它会抬高剩余免费连通的价格；对整段读法陈述同一关系；在关系层读法上排除惰性条件（审查指出关系层的 related 同样可被免费连通）；Ren 在共同参与与交互之间的选择。
next_delta.en: An ordered, effect-sensitive interaction (drawing no later than the dependence, with a level that differs with the draw) and its connected class, which would raise the price of the residual free connection; the same relation for the whole-run reading; excluding idle conditions at the relation level (review notes the relation-level related can also be connected for free); Ren's choice between co-participation and interaction.
